fullPassage: In the 15th century, some Europeans used a strange medicine to stay healthy. It was called "mumia," and it was made from ground-up mummies. People ate it or rubbed it into injuries. They believed it could be used to treat coughs and headaches. However, mumia was not always embraced by the medical community. Additionally, not all patients were willing to try it. Despite this, there was still a high demand for mumia in Europe. Some people dug up Egyptian graves to steal the mummies. Others attempted to turn the bodies of people who had recently died into mummies. Modern people would view this practice as a kind of cannibalism. Medieval Europeans, however, considered it an unusual type of medicine. Fortunately, as medical knowledge advanced, doctors eventually stopped prescribing mumia.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.tip: 미라 약 = strange, 치료 = treat, 여전히 높은 = demand

questions.passage: In the 15th century, some Europeans used a strange medicine to stay healthy. It was called "mumia," and it was made from ground-up mummies. People ate it or rubbed it into injuries. They believed it could be used to treat coughs and headaches. However, mumia was not always embraced by the medical community. Additionally, not all patients were willing to try it. Despite this, there was still a high demand for mumia in Europe. Some people __________ Egyptian graves to steal the mummies. Others attempted to turn the bodies of people who had recently died into mummies. Modern people would view this practice as a kind of cannibalism. Medieval Europeans, however, considered it an unusual type of medicine. Fortunately, as medical knowledge advanced, doctors eventually stopped prescribing mumia.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: gave up=포기했다 / dug up=파냈다 / looked up=찾아봤다 / cleaned up=청소했다
det.analysis:
① gave up: 무덤을 '포기했다'? 미라를 훔치려는 흐름과 무관
② dug up: 이집트 무덤을 '파내어(dug up)' 미라를 훔침 ←정답
③ looked up: '찾아봤다'? 무덤을 찾아본다는 어색
④ cleaned up: '청소했다'? 무관
det.tip: ___ Egyptian graves to steal the mummies = 무덤을 파냄(dug up)

det.korean: a lack of=~의 부족 / instead of=~ 대신에 / in spite of=~에도 불구하고 / a kind of=일종의

① a lack of: 식인 풍습의 '부족'? 어색
